AnnotationUpdate.description: Replaces every field of an annotation that hasn't been exported.
AnnotationUpdate.title: AnnotationUpdate

ApplianceOut.description: A registered appliance with its warranty and latest repairs (newest first).
ApplianceOut.title: ApplianceOut

AttachmentRef.description: An attachment as listed on its message; fetch `/v1/attachments/{id}` for a URL.
AttachmentRef.title: AttachmentRef

DemoLoginRequest.description:
`user_id` is a demo user's id; null signs in as an anonymous guest (no personalization).
`access_code` is required when the API has a demo access code (`/v1/meta`).
DemoLoginRequest.title: DemoLoginRequest

EvalMetricsOut.description:
The metrics `/admin/evals` charts (spec §16.3). Older reports may lack some (null); the
rest of a report's metrics come through as extra keys.
EvalMetricsOut.title: EvalMetricsOut

IssuesCard.description: Problems set aside earlier in the conversation; buttons send `resume_issue`/`close_issue`.
IssuesCard.title: IssuesCard

RegressionAssertions.description: What the replayed reply must (not) do; a subset of the eval runner's `Assertions`.
RegressionAssertions.title: RegressionAssertions

RegressionExportRequest.description:
What the exported case checks. A field left out takes the suggestion for the annotation's
issue types (see `homehelper.quality.export.suggest`).
RegressionExportRequest.title: RegressionExportRequest

RegressionSource.description: Where a case came from, so a failure can be traced back to the reviewed conversation.
RegressionSource.title: RegressionSource

ReplayMedia.description: A photo or video sent with one of the scripted turns, under `data/media/` (git-ignored).
ReplayMedia.title: ReplayMedia

SSEEvent.description: One `data:` payload of the message stream; the SSE `event:` name equals its `type`.
SSEEvent.title: SSEEvent

ScriptedTurn.description:
One user message of a replayed conversation: typed text, a card button press, or both.
A turn with neither must send media (a photo-only message).
ScriptedTurn.title: ScriptedTurn

SendMessageRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages`: text, attachment ids, or a card action.
SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest

StructuredAction.description: A button press from a card; bypasses NLU (spec §7.3).
StructuredAction.title: StructuredAction

WebSource.description: An unofficial web page a step comes from (spec §10.6, ADR-013).
WebSource.title: WebSource

post.description: Export once; the annotation is frozen afterwards. `dry_run` only previews the case.

200.description: Dry run: the case it would export.

get.description: Newest first, `limit` per page; with `sample`, that many random conversations instead.

schema.title: Response List Reports V1 Admin Evals Get

get.description: Every manual in the manifest, to pick the one a reply should have cited.

schema.title: Response List Manuals V1 Admin Manuals Get

get.description: 204 while signed in (or with the header), else 401.

schema.title: Response List Demo Users V1 Auth Demo Users Get
Response List Conversations V1 Conversations Get

post.description: Stream one turn. Guard failures are a single `error` event with a matching status.

409.description: `conversation_busy`: the previous message is still being handled.

422.description: `invalid_attachment`: an attachment can't be sent with this message.

get.description:
Guests have no profile, so they get an empty list, as does a demo user the data platform
does not know (e.g. one removed from `data/mock/` after they signed in). Any other tool
failure (e.g. the database is down) is a 503, not an empty list.

schema.title: Response My Appliances V1 Me Appliances Get

get.description: Serve a locally stored upload to whoever holds an unexpired token (no session needed).

post.description: Upload one photo or video as the multipart field `file`.
